title: Graded syzygy bound for two-variable polynomial rings
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ with the standard grading from [def-sc-p1-standard]. If $M=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}M_n$ is a finitely generated graded $S$-module (so $S_iM_j\subseteq M_{i+j}$), then there are finite graded free $S$-modules $F_0,F_1,F_2$ and an exact sequence of graded modules $0\to F_2\to F_1\to F_0\to M\to0$. Each $F_i$ is a finite direct sum of graded shifts $S(d)$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] (2).
